lines.speaker: THE AUDIT VOICE
lines.text: Your queue is active. Process each case. Apply an action.

lines.speaker: MARA VENN
lines.text: The messages — are they exactly what the sender intended? Or are they processed before they reach us?

lines.speaker: THE AUDIT VOICE
lines.text: Messages are received as transmitted. PMCA does not alter content prior to clerk review.

lines.speaker: MARA VENN
lines.text: And if the documents in a case contradict each other.

lines.speaker: THE AUDIT VOICE
lines.text: You are not an investigator. Apply an action.

lines.speaker: DIRECTOR CALYX
lines.text: Clerk Venn. You came from transit records.

lines.speaker: DIRECTOR CALYX
lines.text: Good instincts, I was told. Reliable. That is what this office requires.

lines.speaker: DIRECTOR CALYX
lines.text: Most of what passes through your hands here, you will not discuss. With anyone. That is not a request.

lines.speaker: DIRECTOR CALYX
lines.text: The dead leave messages. We decide which ones arrive.
